name: astrag-explain
description: Send the current selection to Astrag (C++ AST + LLM) and show the explanation in a panel.

astrag.configPath.description: Path to Astrag YAML config, relative to workspace folder unless absolute.

astrag.cliCommand.description: Used only when launchViaPython is false: executable name or full path (e.g. /path/to/.venv/bin/astrag).

astrag.launchViaPython.description: If true, runs `pythonPath -m astrag.bench.cli vscode-explain` (avoids ENOENT when `astrag` is not on the IDE PATH).

astrag.pythonPath.description: Python for -m mode. Empty: `python.defaultInterpreterPath`, then python3 / python.

astrag.cliCwd.description: Working directory for the CLI. Empty = workspace folder (where compile_commands + config paths resolve).

astrag.sourceRoot.description: If set, paths are relative to workspaceFolder/sourceRoot (must match project_root in Astrag YAML).

astrag.mode.description: http: Astrag server over network (default). cli: local python/astrag process.

astrag.serverUrl.description: Base URL of astrag-server (no trailing slash).

astrag.serverToken.description: Optional X-Astrag-Token if ASTRAG_SERVER_TOKEN is set on the server.

astrag.requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP: max wait for /v1/explain (ms). CLI: kill child after this. Default 10 min.
